body.en: *Fixed capital* is the investment in long-term assets such as land, buildings and machinery. Factors affecting it: nature of business (manufacturing needs more than trading), scale of operations, choice of technique (capital-intensive or labour-intensive), technology upgradation, growth prospects, diversification, financing alternatives such as leasing, and level of collaboration (sharing facilities).
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಎಂದರೆ ಭೂಮಿ, ಕಟ್ಟಡ, ಯಂತ್ರಗಳಂತಹ ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿ ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ. ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸ್ವರೂಪ, ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ, ತಂತ್ರದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಇದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Let us work through this case together. A firm has stock 4,00,000, rupees debtors 3,00,000, rupees cash 2,00,000, rupees creditors 3,50,000 rupees and bills payable 2,00,000 rupees. Find gross and net working capital.
Current assets equals 4,00,000 plus 3,00,000 plus 2,00,000 equals 9,00,000 rupees gross working capital.
Current liabilities equals 3,50,000 plus 2,00,000 equals 5,50,000 rupees.
Net working capital equals 9,00,000 minus 5,50,000 equals 3,50,000 rupees.
So the answer is Gross working capital 9,00,000 rupees; net working capital 3,50,000 rupees.
